text:
## Common Mistakes (Don't Make These!)  
❌ **Mistake 1:** Assuming fraudster is obvious
✅ **Correct:** Fraudsters can be very convincing; stay alert  
❌ **Mistake 2:** Not reporting suspicious activity
✅ **Correct:** Report ALL concerns to Compliance  
❌ **Mistake 3:** Ignoring customer fraud concerns
✅ **Correct:** Take all fraud reports seriously  
❌ **Mistake 4:** Sharing access credentials
✅ **Correct:** Keep credentials private always

raw_entities.name: Fraudster Identification and Vigilance
raw_entities.description: Staff must remain alert to the fact that fraudsters can be very convincing and should not assume fraud is obvious. This obligation emphasizes the need for continuous vigilance and skepticism when evaluating customer interactions and transactions.
context: Fraudsters can be very convincing; stay alert

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Reporting to Compliance
raw_entities.description: Staff must report all concerns and suspicious activity to the Compliance department without exception. This is a mandatory reporting duty that applies to any potential fraud or compliance concern identified.

raw_entities.name: Customer Fraud Report Handling
raw_entities.description: Staff must take all fraud reports from customers seriously and treat them with appropriate urgency and care. This obligation prohibits dismissing or deprioritizing customer-reported fraud concerns.

raw_entities.name: Access Credentials Confidentiality
raw_entities.description: Staff must keep access credentials private at all times and must not share them with any other person or system. This is a fundamental security and data protection obligation.
